RECONCILIATION
Save row counts, key-set differences, duplicate counts and metric totals
before repair. Explain exactly how the primary failure changes
user/business output.
SEVERITY / PUBLISH
Choose block, warn or continue-with-quarantine from impact and consumer
risk. Test result and severity are separate concepts.
OBSERVABILITY
Define SLI/SLO and alert using freshness/completeness/correctness/user
impact; attach run/job/dataset context so evidence correlates.
INCIDENT TIMELINE
Record detection, confirmation, containment, owner, decision, repair
start/end and validation. Separate symptoms from root/contributing causes.
BOUNDED REPAIR
Reprocess/upsert/delete only the affected bounded state with stable keys
and idempotent behavior. Do not erase raw incident evidence.
POST-REPAIR PROOF
Repeat the full source-target reconciliation. Recovery is complete only when
the original failing control and adjacent invariants pass.
PREVENTION / CI
Turn the discovered failure into automated quality/contract checks and
release gates at the correct severity.
IAM / PRIVACY
Use least privilege; secrets are references, not evidence. Redact sensitive
values and prefer short-lived/OIDC auth for CI/CD.
RUNBOOK / IAC / TRADEOFF
Update detect->diagnose->contain->recover->validate steps; plan before
apply; state/locking and rollback/data compatibility remain explicit.
